instruction.text: Adam earns £12 per hour at his supermarket job. Build a formula for E, how much Adam earns, in terms of 𝘩, hours worked.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to find how much Adam earns after working for 3 hours.
Use your formula to find how much Adam earns after working for 7 hours.

instruction.text: Amir runs a business renting out bicycles. He charges a fixed fee of £10 to rent a bike, plus £3 for every hour the bike is used. Build a formula for C, the cost of renting a bike, in terms of 𝘩, hours rented.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate the cost of renting a bike for 5 hours.
Use your formula to calculate the cost of renting a bike for 10 hours.

instruction.text: A freezer starts at a temperature of 5 °C. Every hour, the temperature decreases by 3 °C. Build a formula for T, the temperature, in terms of 𝘩, hours.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate the temperature after 2 hours.
Use your formula to calculate the temperature after 5 hours.

instruction.text: A conveyor belt moves boxes at a constant speed of 4 metres per minute. Boxes are first placed 2 metres from the start of the belt. Build a formula for D, the total distance the box is from the start of the belt, in terms of 𝘮, how many minutes it has been moving.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate the distance a box has travelled after 5 minutes.
Use your formula to calculate the distance a box has travelled after 13 minutes.
